During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a popular '''uprising''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katchan]], prompting the [[Katchan government|planet's government]] to request relief troops to deal with the uprising from one of the galactic powers.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Keep Them Down}}</ref>
